title: Hallucination to Truth: A Review of Fact-Checking and Factuality Evaluation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fact-checking performance disparities by comparing model accuracy on original non-English prompts versus English-translated prompts, and assessing performance differences between high-resource European languages and under-resourced Asian languages.

Adapting factuality evaluation pipelines (e.g., MultiFAct) with non-English knowledge sources to assess the factual consistency and inherent geographic or cultural skews in long-form multilingual LLM generations.
